Central America: Mexico. Panuco and Blanco (Mexico).

Type locality: Río Forlón, Forlón, Rio Panuco drainage, Tamaulipas, Mexico.

IUCN Red List category: Data Deficient (last assessed 2018).

Etymology: Ictalurus comes from the Greek ichthys, meaning fish, and ailouros, meaning cat; literally "fish cat" (catfish). Australis means southern, reflecting the fact that this species is one of the more southern within the genus.
Field Columbian Museum, Zoölogical Series v. 5, pp 13.
